summary: The CEO expressed broad frustration with team velocity, stating that nothing ships on time and deliverables are consistently buggy. The interview was brief and the CEO did not drill into specific root causes or projects, instead characterizing the issue as systemic across all projects.
keyTakeaways: CEO perceives team velocity as too slow across all projects, not isolated to one area
On-time delivery is a major pain point — the CEO feels nothing ships when expected
Quality is a concern alongside speed — deliverables are described as 'always buggy'
The CEO is looking for concrete strategies to improve team speed and output quality

actionItems.description: Identify specific root causes of velocity issues — whether process overhead, scope creep, technical debt, or pipeline bottlenecks — to move from general frustration to targeted fixes

nextMeetingTopics: Root cause analysis of delivery delays — identify which pipeline phases are taking longest

Specific project post-mortems to pinpoint where time is lost
